mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (the current level), or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.8% signals strengthening labor market conditions, which typically precedes higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls below 4.8%, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through increased corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), rising inflation signals potential central bank tightening, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO above 105) indicates expanding manufacturing activity, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through improved corporate earnings visibility.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is above 105, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 104 signals weakening manufacturing, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate profit expectations.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 104, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a robust labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through increased consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: In housing boom regimes (HOUST above 1200), strong housing activity signals elevated consumer confidence and spending, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST exceeds 1200, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
